description: This file defines classes, enums, and constants related to DRM framework, including error codes, buffer management, action descriptions, DRM object types, playback states, actions, rights status, decryption API types, decryption information, and the decryption handle class. It serves as a common interface for DRM operations within the Android framework.

classes.name: DrmBuffer
classes.description: Represents a DRM buffer containing data and its length.

classes.name: ActionDescription
classes.description: Describes detailed action parameters such as output type and configuration.

classes.name: DrmObjectType
classes.description: Defines constants for different DRM object types like unknown, content, rights object, trigger object.

classes.name: Playback
classes.description: Defines playback states such as start, stop, pause, resume.

classes.name: Action
classes.description: Defines actions that can be performed on protected content, e.g., play, ringtone, transfer, output, preview, execute, display.

classes.name: RightsStatus
classes.description: Defines rights status constants such as valid, invalid, expired, not acquired.

classes.name: DecryptApiType
classes.description: Defines decryption API types including non-encrypted, elementary stream based, container based, Widevine based.

classes.name: DecryptInfo
classes.description: Contains information about decryption buffer size and future reserved fields.

classes.name: DecryptHandle
classes.description: Represents a decryption session handle with properties like ID, MIME type, API type, status, decryption info, and control vectors.
